services.name: Cedar shingle siding
services.blurb: Hand-laid cedar shingles in straight, staggered or fancy-cut courses, matched to the house's era.

services.name: Fishscale and fancy-cut repair
services.blurb: Fishscale, diamond and hexagon gable shingles cut and fitted to match the run that is left.

services.name: Clapboard repair
services.blurb: Split and rotten clapboards replaced to the same reveal, primed on all sides against salt air.

services.name: Triple-decker re-siding
services.blurb: Three-story re-sides with the porches, bays and trim lines kept so the house does not look flat.

services.name: Trim and cornice repair
services.blurb: Corner boards, window casings and cornice brackets rebuilt in wood and painted to match.

services.name: Storm repair
services.blurb: Shingles and boards torn off in a nor'easter replaced and matched before the next storm.

services.name: Vinyl siding
services.blurb: Vinyl for owners who want less upkeep, with real trim details kept around windows and doors.

services.name: Color consults
services.blurb: Body, trim and accent colors chosen from Providence's painted houses and tried on a drawing.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Our 1888 Queen Anne in the West End was missing half the fishscale shingles in the front gable. Matteo cut new ones to the same curve, and once painted you cannot tell the old from the new.
reviews.name: Eleanor V.

reviews.text: They re-sided our triple-decker and kept every porch line and both bay windows. It looks like the original house, just straight and tight again.
reviews.name: Joseph A.

reviews.text: After the February nor'easter we lost a strip of shingles on the bay side of the house. They had it matched and closed up within the week.
reviews.name: Helen S.

reviews.text: The clapboards on our Fox Point cottage were split along the bottom three courses. They replaced them at the same 4-inch reveal and back-primed every board against the salt air.
reviews.name: Miguel P.

reviews.text: We picked a body and trim scheme from their book of Providence houses. Sage body, cream trim and a deep red door, and the neighbors stop on the sidewalk to look.
reviews.name: Diana R.

reviews.text: Cedar shingles on our whole cape. It took about three weeks, longer than vinyl would have, but the coursing lines up at every corner and they cleaned up every night.
reviews.name: Robert C.

proof.guarantee: If shingles or boards we installed split, cup or come loose, we come back and replace them at no charge.

prices.note: a few courses up to one wall
